# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}

Delete a specific branch from a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-307`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| branch | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Branch is default/protected or repo is mirror
- **404** — Branch does not exist or repo is empty
- **423** — Repository is archived

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.DeleteBranch | controller | Check repo not empty, not mirror, extract branch name |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | db.Count[git_model.Branch] | repository | Count non-deleted branches to check if sync needed |
| 3 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | repo_module.SyncRepoBranches | service | Sync branches from git to DB if count is 0 |
| 4 | [services](../modules/services.md) | repo_service.DeleteBranch | service | Check archive status, check permissions, check protection, mark deleted in DB, delete from git, send notifications |
| 5 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | gitrepo.DeleteBranch | utility | Delete branch reference from git repository |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Repository must not be empty for branch operations | validation | ctx.Repo.Repository.IsEmpty |
| Repository must not be a mirror for write branch operations | validation | ctx.Repo.Repository.IsMirror |
| Cannot delete default branch or pull request target branch | authorization | branchName == repo.DefaultBranch || branchName == unitPRConfig.DefaultTargetBranch |
| Cannot delete a protected branch | authorization | git_model.IsBranchProtected returns true |
| If no branches in DB for non-empty repo, sync from git immediately | business_logic | totalNumOfBranches == 0 for non-empty repo |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Branch does not exist in git | 404 | notFound | False |
| Trying to delete default or PR target branch | 403 | can not delete default or pull request target branch | False |
| Branch has protection rule | 403 | branch protected | False |

### Error Paths

- **Repo is empty** → ctx.APIError → 404
- **Repo is mirror** → ctx.APIError → 403
- **Branch not exist** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Branch is default** → ctx.APIError → 403
- **Branch is protected** → ctx.APIError → 403

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| medium | synchronous_blocking | SyncRepoBranches is called synchronously if branch count is 0, which walks all git refs | This is a one-time cost per repo; acceptable but could be moved to background |

## 🛡️ Resiliency

**Risk Level:** medium

| Pattern | Status | Severity | Detail |
|---------|--------|----------|--------|
| non_atomic | ✅ configured | medium | Branch deletion uses db.WithTx2 for DB mark + git delete, but post-process notifications are fire-and-forget |

**Non-atomic operations:**
- ⚠️ DB mark as deleted + git branch delete are in a transaction wrapper, but PushUpdate notification is async

**Cascading failure risk:** If git delete fails after DB mark, branch is marked deleted but still exists in git

**Graceful degradation:** Transaction rollback on git failure
